products.name: Radio Broadcasting
products.description: Operation of owned and affiliated radio stations delivering music, news, and entertainment content to multicultural audiences, primarily via terrestrial and digital radio platforms. Content is produced in-house and distributed over regulated broadcast infrastructure and digital channels.

products.name: Television Broadcasting
products.description: Operation of owned and affiliated television stations, including the EstrellaTV network, providing entertainment, news, and culturally relevant programming to diverse audiences via regulated broadcast infrastructure and digital platforms.

products.name: Digital Streaming Channels
products.description: Distribution of video and audio content through digital platforms, including owned apps, third-party partner apps, and Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV (FAST) channels, reaching audiences on connected devices and over-the-top platforms.

products.name: Advertising Sales
products.description: Sales of advertising inventory across radio, television, and digital platforms to local, regional, and national advertisers, leveraging audience reach and data-driven marketing programs. Revenue is generated through direct sales and third-party sales firms.

products.name: Event Production and Sponsorships
products.description: Production and promotion of live events, concerts, and community activities, including securing talent and venues, with revenue from ticket sales and sponsorships. Some events are produced in-house, while others are promoted in partnership with third parties.

products.name: Content Licensing and Syndication
products.description: Licensing and syndication of proprietary audio and video content, including programming supply agreements and network affiliations, to third-party broadcasters and digital platforms for distribution to wider audiences.

products.name: Home Respiratory Therapy Equipment and Services
products.description: Provision and setup of in-home respiratory therapy equipment such as oxygen concentrators, ventilators, and nebulizers, supported by licensed respiratory therapists who deliver and manage patient care in the home setting. This involves physical delivery, setup, and ongoing clinical support.

products.name: Sleep Apnea Therapy Equipment and Services
products.description: Delivery and setup of home-based sleep apnea therapy devices, such as CPAP and BiPAP machines, including patient training and compliance monitoring, requiring physical equipment and ongoing support.

products.name: Mobility and Rehabilitation Equipment
products.description: Provision of mobility aids and complex rehabilitation equipment, including customized wheelchairs and bath safety products, delivered and fitted by certified Assistive Technology Professionals (ATPs) who provide in-person assessments and customization.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides loans to small and mid-sized businesses for purposes such as working capital, inventory, equipment, and capital expansion. These loans are underwritten based on cash flow, collateral, and borrower financial strength, and require in-person relationship management and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Offers loans secured by owner-occupied and non-owner-occupied commercial real estate, including construction, land, and land development loans. These are physically collateralized, require in-person underwriting, and are subject to regulatory oversight.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Originates one-to-four family residential mortgage loans, including closed-end second mortgages and home equity lines of credit, secured by real estate. Loans are underwritten based on borrower creditworthiness and are delivered through both in-person and digital channels.

products.name: Mortgage Warehouse Lending
products.description: Provides short-term lines of credit to mortgage companies, secured by participations in residential mortgages that are sold to secondary market investors. This product requires financial capital, regulatory compliance, and is delivered through business-to-business relationships.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers secured and unsecured loans to individuals for various personal purposes, including auto, personal, and home improvement loans. Delivered through branch and digital channels, requiring credit underwriting and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provides a range of deposit products to individuals, businesses, and municipalities, including checking, savings, money market accounts, and time deposits. Delivered through physical branches and digital platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Insurance Products and Services
products.description: Through its insurance agency subsidiary, offers commercial and personal property and casualty insurance products. Delivered by licensed professionals, requiring regulatory compliance and in-person or remote advisory services.

products.name: Treasury Management and Cash Management Services
products.description: Offers treasury and cash management solutions to business clients, including account management, payment processing, and liquidity solutions. Delivered via digital platforms and in-person advisory, requiring regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Digital Banking Services
products.description: Provides online and mobile banking platforms for retail and business customers, enabling account access, payments, and financial management. Delivered digitally, leveraging third-party technology providers and requiring cybersecurity and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Farmland Leasing
products.description: Ownership and leasing of farmland to independent and corporate farming operations, primarily through triple-net leases, with some leases including variable rent based on farm revenues. Properties are physically acquired and managed, requiring real estate expertise and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Leasing of Farm-Related Facilities
products.description: Ownership and leasing of farm-related facilities such as cooling facilities, packinghouses, processing facilities, and storage facilities, which are necessary to farming operations. These are physical assets delivered through real estate transactions and managed leases.

products.name: Leasing of Commercial Properties Supporting Agricultural Communities
products.description: Acquisition and leasing of commercial properties used by businesses that support farming communities, including farmer-owned cooperatives, rural infrastructure providers, and other agribusinesses. These are physical real estate assets leased to third-party businesses.

products.name: Senior Secured Mortgage Lending on Farmland and Farm-Related Real Estate
products.description: Provision of senior secured first lien mortgage loans to farmers for the purchase of farmland and farm-related real estate. This is a financial service requiring capital and real estate underwriting expertise.

products.name: Direct Farm Operation (Occasional/Temporary)
products.description: Occasional direct operation of farms via management agreements with third-party operators or through a taxable REIT subsidiary, typically on a temporary basis to maintain property value. Involves in-person management and agricultural operations.

products.name: Systematic Equity Investment Strategies
products.description: Systematic, data-driven equity investment strategies managed for institutional and wealth clients, including Emerging Equity, Non-U.S. Equity, Global Equity, Small Cap Equity, Enhanced Equity, and Equity Extensions. Delivered via separate accounts or commingled funds, these strategies are developed and managed using proprietary quantitative models and advanced technology.

products.name: Systematic Credit Investment Strategies
products.description: Quantitative, systematic credit investment strategies for institutional clients, leveraging proprietary models and technology to identify and exploit inefficiencies in credit markets. Delivered through separate accounts or pooled funds.

products.name: Alternative Investment Strategies
products.description: Systematic alternative investment strategies, including non-traditional asset classes and approaches, managed using quantitative models and delivered to institutional and wealth clients via separate accounts or commingled funds.

products.name: Stereo Headphones
products.description: Designed, manufactured, and sold for personal listening, these headphones are produced both in-house and via contract manufacturing in Asia, and distributed globally through retail, distributor, and direct-to-consumer channels.

products.name: Personal Listening Accessories
products.description: Accessory products related to stereo headphones, such as replacement ear cushions and cables, are manufactured or sourced and sold alongside headphones through the same distribution channels.

products.name: OEM Headphone Components and Products
products.description: Headphones and components are sold directly to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) for integration into their own products, requiring coordination with other manufacturers and compliance with OEM specifications.

products.name: Group Disability Insurance
products.description: Provides employers with long-term and short-term disability insurance for employees, covering income loss due to sickness or injury. Delivered through group policies, primarily via workplace channels, and includes rehabilitation and return-to-work services.

products.name: Group Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment Insurance
products.description: Offers group term life insurance and accidental death and dismemberment coverage to employers for their employees, typically linked to wages and delivered through renewable group policies.

products.name: Voluntary Benefits
products.description: Provides a suite of supplemental insurance products (accident, disability, life, hospital indemnity, cancer, and critical illness) sold to employees through payroll deduction, on both group and individual bases, primarily at the workplace.

products.name: Individual Disability Insurance
products.description: Offers individual disability insurance, primarily to employees in multi-life employer groups, providing income replacement for sickness or injury. Policies are portable and tailored to individual needs, with various benefit periods and features.

products.name: Dental and Vision Insurance
products.description: Provides group dental and vision insurance plans to employers, including both insured and self-insured options, covering routine dental and vision care for employees. Delivered as stand-alone or bundled products.

products.name: Fee-Based Administrative Services (Leave Management and ASO)
products.description: Delivers administrative services to employers, including leave management (compliance with leave laws) and administrative services only (ASO) for claims processing and billing for self-insured customers. Provided on a fee basis, not as insurance.

products.name: International Group Disability and Life Insurance
products.description: Provides group long-term disability and group life insurance to employers in the United Kingdom and Poland, covering income loss, death, and related risks for employees. Delivered through local subsidiaries and tailored to local regulations.

products.name: International Supplemental Insurance (Critical Illness, Dental, Health Riders)
products.description: Offers supplemental insurance products in the UK and Poland, including group critical illness, group dental, and accident/health riders, providing lump-sum or fixed benefits for specific health events. Sold through workplace channels.

products.name: Colonial Life Voluntary Benefits (Accident, Sickness, Disability, Life, Cancer, Critical Illness)
products.description: Delivers voluntary insurance products to employees at the workplace, including accident, sickness, short-term disability, life (universal, whole, term), cancer, and critical illness coverage. Marketed through independent agents and brokers.

products.name: Closed Block Long-term Care Insurance
products.description: Legacy group and individual long-term care insurance products, no longer actively marketed, providing benefits for loss of activities of daily living or cognitive impairment. Policies are guaranteed renewable and subject to regulatory repricing.

products.name: FIRDAPSE (amifampridine phosphate)
products.description: A prescription oral tablet medication for the treatment of Lambert-Eaton Myasthenic Syndrome (LEMS), manufactured by third-party contractors and distributed through specialty pharmacies in the U.S., Canada, and Japan. The product is supported by a dedicated field-based sales force and patient support programs, and is supplied to sublicensees for international markets.

products.name: AGAMREE (vamorolone)
products.description: A novel corticosteroid medication for the treatment of Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy (DMD), manufactured under license and supplied by third-party manufacturers, with exclusive rights for North America and sublicensing in Canada. The product is distributed via a dedicated sales force and supported by patient assistance and support programs.

products.name: FYCOMPA (perampanel)
products.description: A prescription medication (tablets and oral suspension) for the treatment of certain types of epilepsy, including focal onset seizures and primary generalized tonic-clonic seizures, acquired and supplied under contract manufacturing agreements. The product is sold in the U.S. despite the entry of generic competition, with manufacturing and supply handled by Eisai under a long-term agreement.

products.name: RNA-based Oncology Therapeutics
products.description: A portfolio of RNA-targeted therapeutics for cancer, including antisense inhibitors, siRNA modulators, and RNA-based agonists, developed using a proprietary modular drug design and delivery platform (TTX). These are manufactured via synthetic oligonucleotide chemistry and delivered using a proprietary nanocarrier system optimized for tumor targeting.

products.name: TTX-MC138 (Antisense microRNA-10b Inhibitor)
products.description: A lead RNA therapeutic candidate targeting microRNA-10b for the treatment of metastatic cancers, produced via synthetic oligonucleotide manufacturing and delivered using the proprietary TTX platform. Undergoing clinical trials for multiple solid tumor indications.

products.name: Seviprotimut-L (Melanoma Antigen Vaccine)
products.description: A polyvalent antigen cancer vaccine derived from proprietary human melanoma cell lines, intended to reduce recurrence risk in high-risk melanoma patients. Manufactured using cell culture and purification processes, administered as an injectable biologic.

products.name: Oncolytic Immunotherapy Platform (UIO-524, UIO-525, UIO-526)
products.description: A next-generation platform of genetically engineered oncolytic adenoviruses designed to selectively replicate in tumor and stromal cells and deliver multi-cytokine immune-activating payloads for solid tumor treatment. Manufactured via viral engineering and biotechnology processes.

products.name: TTX-siPDL1 (siRNA-based PD-L1 Modulator)
products.description: A preclinical siRNA therapeutic targeting PD-L1 to modulate immune checkpoint pathways in cancer, produced via synthetic oligonucleotide chemistry and delivered using the TTX platform.

products.name: TTX-RIGA (RNA-based RIG-I Agonist)
products.description: A preclinical RNA therapeutic designed to activate the innate immune system via RIG-I agonism in tumor cells, using the proprietary TTX delivery platform. Manufactured through synthetic RNA chemistry.

products.name: TTX-siMYC (siRNA-based MYC Inhibitor)
products.description: A preclinical siRNA therapeutic targeting the c-MYC oncogene, produced via synthetic oligonucleotide chemistry and delivered using the TTX platform, intended for various MYC-driven cancers.

products.name: COVID-19 Vaccine (Nuvaxovid)
products.description: A recombinant protein-based nanoparticle vaccine for the prevention of COVID-19, manufactured using a baculovirus insect cell-expression system and formulated with the proprietary Matrix-M™ adjuvant. Delivered as finished doses to customers and commercialized globally through direct sales and partnerships.

products.name: Matrix-M™ Adjuvant Supply and Licensing
products.description: Proprietary saponin-based adjuvant supplied as a standalone product to external partners for use in their vaccine products, including through commercial supply agreements and non-exclusive licensing for use in infectious disease and oncology vaccine candidates.

products.name: R21/Matrix-M™ Adjuvant Malaria Vaccine (via partnership)
products.description: A malaria vaccine developed by the Jenner Institute, University of Oxford, and manufactured by Serum Institute of India, formulated with Novavax's Matrix-M™ adjuvant, with Novavax supplying the adjuvant and receiving royalties on vaccine sales.

products.name: COVID-19 and Influenza Combination Vaccine (CIC) Candidates
products.description: Combination vaccine candidates targeting both COVID-19 and influenza, developed using Novavax's recombinant protein nanoparticle technology and Matrix-M™ adjuvant, with clinical trials conducted and out-licensing to partners for further development and commercialization.

products.name: Stand-alone Influenza Vaccine Candidates
products.description: Recombinant protein-based nanoparticle vaccines for seasonal influenza, formulated with Matrix-M™ adjuvant, developed and manufactured using the baculovirus insect cell-expression system, with clinical trials completed and partnering sought for commercialization.

products.name: Ketamine-Based Therapeutics (NRX-100 and KETAFREE)
products.description: Proprietary and generic preservative-free intravenous ketamine formulations for the treatment of depression, including suicidal depression and bipolar depression. These are physically manufactured, require FDA approval, and are distributed as pharmaceutical products to healthcare providers.

products.name: NRX-101 (Oral D-cycloserine and Lurasidone Combination)
products.description: An oral fixed-dose combination drug for the treatment of bipolar depression with suicidal ideation and as an adjunct to TMS. Manufactured as a pharmaceutical product, requiring FDA approval, and distributed to healthcare providers.

products.name: Interventional Psychiatry Clinical Services (HOPE Therapeutics Clinics)
products.description: Comprehensive in-person psychiatric care for treatment-resistant depression and PTSD, delivered through owned and acquired clinics. Services include administration of neuroplastic drugs (e.g., ketamine, NRX-101), TMS, hyperbaric therapy, digital therapeutics, and psychotherapy/medication management.

products.name: Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS) Services and Protocols
products.description: Provision of TMS treatments, including advanced protocols such as ONE-D, often combined with neuroplastic drugs, delivered in clinical settings using specialized devices and neuro-navigation techniques.

products.name: Digital Therapeutics for Psychiatric Disorders
products.description: Digital-only interventions and monitoring tools for depression, PTSD, and suicidality, deployed across clinical sites to support accountable care and enhance psychiatric treatment outcomes.

products.name: Hyperbaric Therapy Services
products.description: In-person hyperbaric oxygen therapy provided as part of comprehensive psychiatric treatment at clinical sites, requiring specialized equipment and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by owner-occupied and non-owner occupied commercial real estate properties, including retail, hospitality, service operations, and warehouses. Loans are physically underwritten, collateralized by real estate, and serviced through branch and banker relationships.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination and sale of non-conforming residential mortgage loans, primarily single-family, through branch network. Loans are physically underwritten, collateralized by residential real estate, and may be sold to investors with servicing rights retained.

products.name: Construction and Development Lending
products.description: Origination of loans for commercial construction and land acquisition/development, including hotels, office buildings, and specialty properties. Loans are physically underwritten, disbursed based on project completion, and secured by real estate.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Lending
products.description: Origination of secured and unsecured loans to small and medium-sized businesses for working capital, equipment, inventory, and business expansion. Loans are physically underwritten and may be collateralized by business assets.

products.name: SBA and USDA Lending and Servicing
products.description: Origination and servicing of government-guaranteed loans (SBA and USDA) for business property acquisition, working capital, and expansion. Loans are physically underwritten, often secured by real estate, and servicing rights are retained on sold portions.

products.name: Deposit Products
products.description: Provision of traditional deposit accounts including checking, savings, money market, and certificates of deposit to individuals and businesses. Products are delivered through physical branches and digital channels, and are FDIC insured.

products.name: Treasury and Cash Management Services
products.description: Provision of commercial treasury management and cash management services such as balance reporting, ACH origination, wire transfers, remote deposit capture, and sweep accounts. Services are delivered digitally and through branch support.

products.name: Trade Finance Services
products.description: Provision of trade finance-related services including domestic and international letters of credit, international collections, and export advice. Services are denominated in U.S. currency and fully collateralized.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provision of consumer loans, primarily overdrafts and consumer lines of credit, to individuals. Loans are underwritten and dependent on borrower financial stability.

products.name: Online and Mobile Banking Services
products.description: Provision of digital banking services including online account access, transfers, bill payment, mobile check deposit, and electronic statements. Services are delivered via web and mobile applications.

products.name: Vertically-Tailored Business Management Software
products.description: Cloud-based SaaS platforms designed for specific service SMB verticals (Home Services, Health Services, Wellness), providing workflow automation, scheduling, dispatching, project management, and customer-facing experiences. Delivered digitally via web and mobile applications.

products.name: Billing & Payment Solutions
products.description: Integrated digital payment processing, billing, invoicing automation, and business intelligence tools for SMBs, including point-of-sale, eCommerce, recurring billing, and mobile payments. Delivered as SaaS and embedded within business management platforms.

products.name: Customer Experience Solutions
products.description: SaaS tools for customer engagement, reputation management, digital communication, customer feedback, and AI-powered virtual assistants, enabling businesses to manage customer interactions and improve retention. Delivered digitally via web and mobile.

products.name: Home Services Software Suite (EverPro)
products.description: Integrated SaaS solutions tailored for home service professionals (e.g., contractors, field service, security), including project management, field service management, and lead generation tools. Delivered digitally via web and mobile.

products.name: Health Services Software Suite (EverHealth)
products.description: Integrated SaaS solutions for health service professionals, including practice management, electronic health record (EHR/EMR), and patient engagement tools. Delivered digitally and designed for compliance with healthcare regulations.

products.name: Wellness Services Software Suite (EverWell)
products.description: Integrated SaaS solutions for wellness professionals (salons, spas, massage therapists), including scheduling, facility access, relationship management, and inventory management. Delivered digitally via web and mobile.

products.name: AI-Powered Customer Engagement Solutions (ZyraTalk)
products.description: AI-driven virtual assistant and automation platform for customer engagement, providing autonomous workflows and field service management, integrated into core vertical SaaS offerings. Delivered digitally.

products.name: Other Vertically-Tailored SaaS Solutions
products.description: Select SaaS solutions for additional service verticals such as education, non-profit, pet care, and automotive repair, providing workflow and customer management tools. Delivered digitally.

products.name: Individual and Family Health Insurance Plans
products.description: Comprehensive health insurance plans offered to individuals and families through ACA Health Insurance Marketplaces and off-exchange, built on a cloud-native technology platform and delivered via digital and broker channels. Plans are physically underwritten, regulated, and require network contracting with providers.

products.name: ICHRA-Enabled Health Insurance Plans
products.description: Health insurance plans designed for employees whose employers offer Individual Coverage Health Reimbursement Arrangements (ICHRA), allowing employees to purchase Oscar plans with employer contributions. Delivered via digital and broker channels, leveraging Oscar's technology and network.

products.name: +Oscar Technology Platform
products.description: A cloud-native, full stack technology platform licensed to external healthcare providers and payors, offering engagement, recommendation, analytics, and automation tools (including Campaign Builder) to improve care delivery and member engagement. Delivered as a digital SaaS solution.

products.name: Brokerage and Enrollment Services
products.description: Marketplace and brokerage services for individual medical and supplemental health products, including a CMS-approved direct enrollment platform (Lucie, Inc.), a multi-carrier brokerage (IHC Specialty Benefits, Inc.), and consumer education (Healthinsurance.org). Delivered digitally and via licensed brokers.

products.name: CNS Small Molecule Therapies
products.description: Orally available, precision small molecule drugs developed using computational and experimental tools to target genetic causes of central nervous system (CNS) disorders, including movement disorders and epilepsy. These therapies are physically manufactured and delivered as oral medications.

products.name: Antisense Oligonucleotide (ASO) Therapies for CNS Disorders
products.description: Targeted, precision antisense oligonucleotide drugs developed using proprietary computational workflows to modulate gene expression in CNS disorders. These are manufactured biologic drugs, delivered via intrathecal or other routes, and are designed for specific genetic mutations.

products.name: Senior Secured Loans
products.description: Loans to U.S. middle-market companies, structured as first-priority liens on borrower assets, typically with moderate amortization and majority of principal due at maturity. These are physically originated and require significant financial capital and underwriting expertise.

products.name: One Stop Loans (Unitranche Loans)
products.description: Single loans that combine characteristics of senior secured and subordinated debt, structured as senior secured loans with first-priority liens, often provided as the sole lender to middle-market companies. These require financial structuring, underwriting, and ongoing monitoring.

products.name: Second Lien Loans
products.description: Subordinated, secured loans with second-priority liens on borrower assets, typically with minimal amortization and principal due at maturity. These are originated through private transactions and require specialized credit analysis and structuring.

products.name: Subordinated Loans
products.description: Unsecured, subordinated loans to middle-market companies, providing relatively high, fixed interest rates and significant current interest income, with principal typically due at maturity. These require financial capital and credit risk management.

products.name: Equity Co-Investments and Warrants
products.description: Minority equity investments and warrants in portfolio companies, typically made alongside loans and structured to provide additional return if the company appreciates in value. These are negotiated in connection with debt investments and require legal and financial structuring.

products.name: Managerial Assistance Services
products.description: Organizational, financial, and operational guidance provided to portfolio companies upon request, including board participation and consulting. Delivered by investment professionals and administrative staff, sometimes for a fee.

products.name: Residential Property Leasing
products.description: Leasing of residential apartment units and condominium units, primarily in the metropolitan Boston area, through ownership and operation of apartment complexes and condominium units. Properties are physically owned, managed, and maintained, requiring in-person labor and regulated real estate infrastructure.

products.name: Commercial Property Leasing
products.description: Leasing of commercial space, including shopping centers, commercial buildings, and commercial units in mixed-use properties, primarily in Massachusetts. Properties are physically owned and managed, requiring ongoing maintenance and tenant management.

products.name: LMM Commercial Real Estate Loans
products.description: Origination, acquisition, financing, and servicing of lower middle market (LMM) commercial real estate loans, including construction, bridge, fixed rate, and agency multifamily loans. These loans are secured by commercial properties and delivered through a nationwide platform, often held for investment, securitized, or sold to agencies like Freddie Mac.

products.name: Affordable Housing Financing
products.description: Origination and provision of construction and permanent financing for the preservation and construction of affordable housing, primarily utilizing tax-exempt bonds. Delivered through specialized subsidiaries and often involves complex regulatory and tax structures.

products.name: SBA 7(a) Small Business Loans
products.description: Origination, acquisition, and servicing of owner-occupied small business loans guaranteed by the SBA under the Section 7(a) Program. These loans are used for a variety of business purposes and are delivered through a licensed non-bank SBLC subsidiary, with portions sold or securitized.

products.name: USDA Small Business Loans
products.description: Origination and servicing of small business loans guaranteed by the USDA, delivered through subsidiaries and focused on eligible rural businesses. These loans are typically held for investment or sold.

products.name: Commercial Banking Services
products.description: Provides a full range of banking products and services to commercial customers, including lending, deposit accounts, and cash management, primarily delivered through physical branches and digital channels, requiring regulated infrastructure and financial capital.

products.name: Personal Banking Services
products.description: Offers retail banking products such as checking and savings accounts, personal loans, mortgages, and debit/credit cards to individual consumers, delivered via branches, ATMs, and digital platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure and financial capital.

products.name: Institutional Banking Services
products.description: Provides specialized banking services to institutional clients, including government entities and correspondent banks, involving deposit, lending, and payment solutions, delivered through dedicated relationship managers and digital platforms.

products.name: Asset Management and Trust Services
products.description: Delivers asset management, investment advisory, and trust services to individuals and institutions, involving in-person advisory, fiduciary oversight, and digital portfolio management, requiring regulatory compliance and financial expertise.

products.name: Fund Services (Fund Accounting and Transfer Agency)
products.description: Provides fund accounting, transfer agency, and related administrative services to mutual funds and alternative investment groups, delivered through specialized nonbank subsidiaries using digital and human resources, subject to financial regulations.

products.name: Bankcard Services
products.description: Offers credit and debit card products and related payment processing services to consumers and businesses, requiring regulated payment infrastructure and digital transaction processing.

products.name: Cash Management Services
products.description: Provides cash management solutions such as treasury management, payment processing, and liquidity services to business and institutional clients, delivered via digital platforms and in-person support, requiring regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Tissue-Based Molecular Profiling Solutions (MI Profile, including MI Cancer Seek)
products.description: Comprehensive tissue-based molecular profiling solutions for cancer therapy selection, utilizing whole exome and transcriptome sequencing (WES/WTS), immunohistochemistry (IHC), and AI-powered bioinformatics to generate individualized reports for clinicians and biopharma partners. Requires physical laboratory processing of tumor tissue and advanced computational analysis.

products.name: Blood-Based Molecular Profiling Solutions (Caris Assure)
products.description: Blood-based molecular profiling solutions for cancer therapy selection, minimal residual disease (MRD) tracking, and treatment monitoring, using WES/WTS of plasma and white blood cells, with AI/ML analysis to distinguish tumor variants. Delivered as a less invasive alternative to tissue biopsy, processed in high-throughput labs.

products.name: Whole Genome Sequencing-Based Profiling Solutions (Precision Whole Genome Platform: Caris Detect, Caris WGS MRD, Caris ChromoSeq)
products.description: Comprehensive whole genome sequencing (WGS) solutions for early cancer detection (Caris Detect), MRD tracking (Caris WGS MRD), and therapy selection in hematological cancers (Caris ChromoSeq), using blood and tissue samples, advanced sequencing, and proprietary AI/ML algorithms. Delivered via laboratory testing and digital reporting.

products.name: Proprietary Molecular AI/ML Signatures (e.g., GPSai, FOLFIRSTai, MI Clarity)
products.description: AI/ML-driven molecular signatures and predictive algorithms for cancer diagnosis, therapy response prediction, and recurrence risk assessment, developed using large clinico-genomic datasets and integrated into profiling reports. Delivered digitally as part of clinical and research services.

products.name: Biopharma Research and Drug Target Discovery Services (Caris Discovery)
products.description: Drug target and therapeutic discovery services for biopharma partners, leveraging proprietary multi-omic datasets, AI/ML analysis, wet lab proteomics, and the ADAPT platform to identify novel drug targets and develop therapeutics, including antibody-drug conjugates, small molecules, and cell therapies. Delivered through research collaborations and service agreements.

products.name: Multi-Modal Clinico-Genomic Data Licensing and Analytics (Caris Strategic Data)
products.description: Licensing of deidentified, multi-modal clinico-genomic datasets and analytics services to external researchers and biopharma companies, enabling drug discovery, translational research, and clinical trial design. Delivered digitally with secure data access and AI/ML-powered analysis tools.

products.name: Immunohistochemistry (IHC) Testing Services
products.description: Comprehensive menu of third-party IHC tests to assess protein-based biomarkers in patient specimens, supporting molecular profiling, therapy selection, and diagnostic refinement. Requires laboratory processing of tissue samples and integration with sequencing data.

products.name: MDI and Formulated Polyurethane Systems
products.description: Manufactured at large-scale facilities, these chemicals (MDI, polyols, and formulated systems) are used to produce rigid and flexible foams, coatings, adhesives, sealants, elastomers, and composite wood products. Delivered as component molecules or fully formulated systems to industrial customers globally.

products.name: Thermoplastic Polyurethane (TPU)
products.description: Produced at dedicated facilities, TPU is a high-quality, fully formulated thermoplastic tailored for injection molding, extrusion into films, wires, and cables, and used in automotive, footwear, and industrial applications. Delivered as finished resin to manufacturers.

products.name: Spray Polyurethane Foam (SPF) Insulation Systems
products.description: Manufactured and distributed primarily in North America, SPF insulation systems are produced using proprietary processes that recycle PET plastic bottles into energy-saving polyurethane insulation for residential and commercial buildings. Delivered as ready-to-use foam systems.

products.name: Amines
products.description: Produced at global manufacturing sites, amines (including polyetheramines, ethyleneamines, and specialty amines) are intermediate chemicals used as reactive agents, emulsifiers, dispersants, solvents, and catalysts in applications such as epoxy composites, coatings, fuel additives, gas treating, and semiconductor manufacturing. Delivered as bulk chemicals to industrial customers.

products.name: Maleic Anhydride
products.description: Manufactured using proprietary fixed bed butane-based processes, maleic anhydride is a chemical intermediate used primarily to produce unsaturated polyester resins for fiberglass, construction, automotive, marine, and recreation products, as well as additives for lubricants, copolymers, and food acidulants. Delivered as a bulk chemical to industrial customers.

products.name: Advanced Epoxy, Phenoxy, Acrylic, Polyurethane, and Acrylonitrile-Butadiene-Based Polymer Formulations
products.description: Produced at global synthesis and formulation facilities, these technologically advanced polymer formulations are used in aerospace, automotive, electronics, adhesives, composites, coatings, and construction. Delivered as specialty resins, adhesives, and composite systems tailored to customer specifications.

products.name: High Performance Thermoset Resins, Curing and Toughening Agents, and Carbon Nanotube Additives
products.description: Manufactured at specialized facilities, these chemical building blocks and additives are sold to formulators for use in aerospace, automotive, oil and gas, coatings, construction, electronics, and electrical insulation. Delivered as specialty chemicals and additives for advanced material applications.

products.name: Timberland Log Sales
products.description: Sale of delivered logs and stumpage (standing timber) from sustainably managed timberlands to external customers, including sawlogs and pulpwood. Timber is harvested from company-owned forests and sold under both long-term supply agreements and spot market transactions.

products.name: Wood Products (Lumber, Plywood, and Residuals)
products.description: Manufacture and sale of softwood lumber, industrial grade plywood, and wood residuals (such as sawdust, shavings, chips, and bark) produced at company-owned mills. Products are distributed nationwide to end users, retailers, and wholesalers, primarily for construction and industrial uses.

products.name: Rural Land Sales
products.description: Sale of rural timberland and non-core real estate parcels for recreational, conservation, commercial, residential, or alternative energy uses. Land is sold directly to third parties, including investors and organizations, based on periodic assessments of highest value use.

products.name: Real Estate Development (Residential and Commercial)
products.description: Development and sale of residential lots and commercial sites, primarily in master-planned communities such as Chenal Valley and Red Oak Ridge. The company provides infrastructure and improvements to support the sale of developed properties to homebuilders, individuals, and businesses.

products.name: Leasing and Royalties (Recreation, Minerals, Carbon Sequestration)
products.description: Leasing of timberland for recreational purposes (such as hunting), mineral rights, and carbon sequestration projects. The company grants rights to third parties for exploration, development, and use of land resources in exchange for rents and royalties.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a broad range of lending products including term loans, revolving lines of credit, and construction financing to small and medium sized businesses, real estate professionals, and financial sponsors. These loans are originated and managed by specialized teams and require significant financial capital and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Offers fixed and floating rate term loans, construction financing, and revolving lines of credit secured by various property types to experienced real estate professionals. Delivery involves in-person relationship management and regulated underwriting.

products.name: Sponsor Finance
products.description: Provides senior secured financing solutions to private equity-backed lower middle market companies for acquisitions, recapitalizations, and growth investments. Requires specialized financial structuring and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Syndicated Lending
products.description: Participates in syndicated loans by acquiring whole loans or purchasing participations from lead banks, targeting transactions in home mortgage, CRE, and C&I categories. Involves financial capital deployment and risk management.

products.name: Small Business Lending (SBA/USDA Loans)
products.description: Originates and services U.S. government guaranteed loans (SBA and USDA) for small businesses nationwide, selling the guaranteed portion and retaining servicing rights. Requires specialized underwriting and compliance with government programs.

products.name: Equipment Leasing
products.description: Provides small ticket equipment leasing solutions to equipment vendors and end users in manufacturing, construction, wholesale, and healthcare sectors. Involves origination, underwriting, and servicing of leases nationwide.

products.name: Deposit Products (Consumer and Commercial)
products.description: Offers a wide variety of deposit products including non-interest-bearing accounts, money market accounts, savings accounts, checking accounts, and time deposits to consumers and businesses. Delivered through branches, online, and mobile platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Treasury Management Services
products.description: Provides business customers with treasury services such as payment processing, information reporting, fraud management, cash collection, and interest rate derivatives. Delivered via branch, online, and mobile interfaces, requiring digital and human resources.

products.name: Trust and Wealth Management Services
products.description: Delivers investment, trust, and wealth management services including fiduciary, executor, financial planning, investment advisory, and private banking to individuals, foundations, and endowments. Requires credentialed professionals and regulated processes.

products.name: Drilling Equipment and Rig Systems
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and supports advanced land rigs, offshore drilling packages, and rig components, including automation control systems and robotics. Delivered as large-scale capital equipment with aftermarket support, upgrades, and field services.

products.name: Drill Bits and Borehole Enlargement Tools
products.description: Designs, manufactures, sells, and rents performance-engineered drill bits, borehole enlargement products, and coring tools for rotary drilling operations. Products are physically manufactured and customized for demanding drilling applications.

products.name: Downhole Tools and Intervention Equipment
products.description: Provides downhole drilling motors, agitator systems, measurement-while-drilling, logging-while-drilling, fishing, coiled tubing, and thru-tubing tools, as well as intervention and stimulation equipment for hydraulic stimulation, coiled tubing, and wireline services. Products are manufactured and supported with engineering and field services.

products.name: Completion Tools and Well Construction Products
products.description: Offers proprietary completion tools and solutions, including multistage frac technologies, frac plugs, sleeves, liner hangers, and remotely activated advanced completion tools. Products are manufactured and delivered for well construction and completions.

products.name: Artificial Lift Systems and Pumps
products.description: Designs and manufactures electric submersible pumps, high viscosity pumps, surface pumps, and artificial lift support systems to optimize oil and gas production. Products are physically manufactured and installed in production operations.

products.name: Tubular Inspection, Coating, and Repair Services
products.description: Provides integrated inspection, coating, and repair services for drill pipe and oil country tubular goods, including specialized composite sleeves and liners. Services are delivered through field and facility-based operations.

products.name: Solids Control and Waste Management Solutions
products.description: Manufactures, sells, and rents solids control equipment and provides waste management services, including field services, transport, storage, and water management. Incorporates proprietary technologies for efficient waste minimization and treatment.

products.name: Digital Solutions and Analytics Platforms
products.description: Provides digital platforms, edge devices, and analytics services for real-time data acquisition, aggregation, and analysis in drilling, completion, and production operations. Solutions are delivered via proprietary software, sensors, and field service infrastructure.

products.name: Drill Pipe and Drill-Stem Equipment
products.description: Designs and manufactures precision-engineered drill pipe and drill-stem equipment using advanced metallurgy and premium connection technologies for demanding drilling applications.

products.name: Conductor Casing and Connection Solutions
products.description: Provides proprietary connectors and integral thread solutions for conductor strings, surface casing, and liners, engineered for high fatigue loading and demanding oil and gas applications.

products.name: Composite Pipe, Tanks, and Structures
products.description: Designs and manufactures high-end composite pipe, tanks, and structures for applications in oil and gas, chemical processing, industrial, marine, and renewable energy sectors. Products address corrosion and weight constraints and are physically manufactured.

products.name: Marine and Offshore Construction Equipment
products.description: Provides heavy-lift cranes, deck-handling machinery, mooring and anchoring systems, jacking systems, and specialized equipment for offshore wind and oil & gas construction vessels. Includes design and manufacture of vessels and floating structures.

products.name: Process and Separation Systems
products.description: Provides integrated processing solutions for separation and treatment of oil, gas, solids, seawater, and produced water, including MEG reclamation and carbon capture technologies. Systems are engineered and delivered for onshore and offshore production facilities.

products.name: Subsea Production Systems
products.description: Designs and manufactures flexible subsea pipe systems and critical subsea production equipment for offshore hydrocarbon production, including water injection and tie-in connector systems and subsea storage units.

products.name: Industrial Fluid Handling Equipment
products.description: Manufactures progressive cavity pumps, mixers, and heat exchangers for industrial markets such as wastewater, chemical, food and beverage, mineral processing, and biogas. Products are physically manufactured and marketed under recognized brands.

products.name: Renewable Energy Equipment and Solutions (Wind, Geothermal, Carbon Capture, Nuclear)
products.description: Develops and supplies equipment and technology for offshore and onshore wind projects, geothermal drilling and production, carbon capture and sequestration, and advanced nuclear deployment. Solutions leverage NOV’s manufacturing, engineering, and project management capabilities.

products.name: Respiratory Therapeutics Royalties
products.description: Royalties from partnered respiratory drugs, specifically RELVAR®/BREO® ELLIPTA® (fluticasone furoate/vilanterol) and ANORO® ELLIPTA® (umeclidinium bromide/vilanterol), which are manufactured and commercialized by GSK for asthma and COPD. Innoviva receives a percentage of global net sales as royalty income.

products.name: Critical Care and Infectious Disease Therapeutics
products.description: A portfolio of five differentiated, approved, commercial and marketed hospital-focused drugs for critical care and infectious diseases: GIAPREZA® (angiotensin II), XACDURO® (sulbactam/durlobactam), XERAVA® (eravacycline), ZEVTERA® (ceftobiprole), and NUZOLVENCE® (zoliflodacin). These are manufactured by third parties and delivered as injectable or oral pharmaceuticals to hospitals and healthcare providers.

products.name: Strategic Healthcare Asset Investments
products.description: Equity and economic interests in other healthcare companies, such as Armata Pharmaceuticals, through a portfolio investment approach. These are financial investments rather than direct product sales, but may generate returns from external healthcare businesses.

products.name: Housewares and Small Electrical Appliances
products.description: Designs, markets, and distributes a wide range of housewares and small electrical appliances such as pressure cookers, canners, skillets, griddles, deep fryers, slow cookers, waffle makers, pizza ovens, slicer/shredders, electric heaters, corn poppers, dehydrators, vacuum sealers, coffeemakers, electric knife sharpeners, and timers. Products are primarily sourced from vendors in the Orient and distributed through retailers and independent distributors in the US and Canada.

products.name: Ordnance and Ammunition Products
products.description: Manufactures and delivers 40mm ammunition, precision mechanical and electro-mechanical assemblies, medium caliber cartridge cases, and metal parts for the US Department of Defense and prime contractors. Also performs Load, Assemble and Pack (LAP) operations and produces detonators, booster pellets, release cartridges, lead azide, and other military energetic devices and materials. Products are manufactured in dedicated facilities and delivered under large, multi-year government contracts.

products.name: Safety Detection Devices
products.description: Provides safety technology products including smoke alarms, carbon monoxide (CO) alarms, combo smoke/CO alarms with voice messages, and PFAS-Free Foam commercial fire extinguishers. Products are developed with features such as large digital displays and are distributed to organizations and individuals, primarily in the US, through a small sales force and manufacturer representatives.

products.name: Performance Marketing Services
products.description: Delivery of measurable, cost-effective customer acquisition results (qualified clicks, leads, calls, applications, or customers) for clients in financial services and home services verticals, using proprietary digital marketing technologies and a mix of owned and third-party online media. Services are delivered digitally and require significant technology, data analytics, and media buying expertise.

products.name: Pipes, Valves & Fittings
products.description: Distribution of pipes, valves, hydrants, and fittings made from materials such as PVC, ductile iron, fusible HDPE, and copper, used for water and wastewater transmission networks. Products are sourced from suppliers, stocked in branches, and delivered to customers, requiring compliance with municipal, state, and federal specifications.

products.name: Storm Drainage Products
products.description: Distribution of storm drainage products including corrugated HDPE and metal piping systems, retention basins, inline drains, manholes, grates, geosynthetics, and related products for stormwater management. Products are sourced, stocked, and delivered to customers for use in construction and repair of stormwater systems.

products.name: Fire Protection Products and Services
products.description: Distribution of fire protection products such as pipe, valves, fittings, sprinkler heads, and accessories, along with customized fabrication and kitting services. Products are delivered to commercial, institutional, industrial, warehouse, and multi-family buildings, meeting strict quality and regulatory standards.

products.name: Metering Solutions (Smart Metering and Water Meters)
products.description: Distribution and installation of water meters and advanced metering infrastructure, including automated meter reading, network infrastructure, software installation, training, and long-term service contracts. These solutions are delivered to customers to enable water volume measurement, leak detection, and operational efficiencies.

products.name: Project Planning and Management Services
products.description: Provision of project planning, material take-off, estimating, bid preparation, and delivery coordination services for water, wastewater, storm drainage, and fire protection infrastructure projects. Services are delivered by technical sales associates and specialists, leveraging proprietary technology tools and local expertise.

products.name: Direct Distribution and Logistics Services
products.description: Provision of direct distribution and logistics services, including sourcing and arranging delivery of large quantities of products directly from suppliers to customer jobsites, supporting inventory management and delivery scheduling for large-scale projects.

products.name: Financial Reporting Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based software solutions for automating, managing, and filing financial reports, including SEC, SEDAR, ESEF, statutory, annual, interim, and management reporting. Delivered as a SaaS platform, integrating with ERP and other systems, supporting XBRL/iXBRL tagging, and enabling collaborative workflows.

products.name: Sustainability Management Solutions
products.description: SaaS platform for collecting, managing, and reporting sustainability and ESG data, supporting frameworks like GRI, SASB, TCFD, and SDGs. Enables organizations to streamline sustainability disclosures, carbon accounting, and compliance with regulations such as CSRD and California’s climate acts.

products.name: Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based suite for managing internal controls, risk management, internal audit, policy management, and compliance processes. Enables documentation, assessment, and reporting for SOX, ERM, and other regulatory requirements, with collaborative workflows and audit trails.

products.name: Industry-Specific Regulatory Reporting Solutions
products.description: Tailored SaaS solutions for regulatory, financial, risk, and sustainability reporting in verticals such as financial services, public sector, and energy/utilities. Includes support for banking, insurance, investment firm, government, and utility regulatory requirements and filings.

products.name: Professional Services
products.description: Consulting and support services including initial setup, XBRL mapping/tagging/review, best practices implementation, and business process consulting to help customers optimize use of the Workiva platform.

products.name: Technical Athletic Apparel
products.description: A comprehensive line of pants, shorts, tops, and jackets designed for athletic activities and healthy lifestyle, produced using technically advanced fabrics and innovative functional features, and sold through physical retail stores, e-commerce, and wholesale partners.

products.name: Athletic Footwear
products.description: Footwear designed for athletic and lifestyle use, leveraging technical innovation and premium materials, distributed through retail stores and digital channels.

products.name: Fitness-Inspired Accessories
products.description: Accessories such as bags, hats, water bottles, yoga mats, and other fitness-related items, designed to complement athletic and on-the-move lifestyles, sold through retail and online channels.

products.name: Re-commerce Program (Like New)
products.description: A re-commerce service where guests can exchange gently used lululemon products for merchandise credit, with products verified and resold online, supporting a circular ecosystem.

products.name: Co-branded and Wholesale Products
products.description: Co-branded lululemon products sold through wholesale arrangements with fitness studios, athletic organizations, corporate sales, university campus retailers, and other partners, expanding brand reach and access.
